verdicts.reason: A keeps the panel, type and corner marks as one centred, balanced unit, but it is a near-unchanged copy of the original: the panel fills only half the square, so the headline is undersized, and stray dark triangles show at the panel's top and bottom-left corners. B's text is bigger, but the panel sits high (95px gap above, 190px below) and leaves a big empty band between the rule and 'Join WADE team'. Its bottom slash and circle float far below the panel, cut off from the frame motif they belong to, so the layout looks unplanned.
